subject: processing the metashort csv. data for every quarter hour (15 min)

messages.subject: processing the metashort csv. data for every quarter hour (15 min)
parts:
Dear all,

We solved the problem with the variable MAD and the aggregation of every minute, thanks to Ben, Jairo and Vincent.
Now, we are looking to process the metashort csv. data for every quarter hour (15 min) by using the following code:

GGIR::GGIR(
    mode = c(1,2,3,4,5),
    datadir ="/home/data_raw",
    outputdir ="/home/output_data",
    do.report = c(2,4,5),
    f0 = 1, f1 = 1,
    do.parallel = TRUE,
    #=====================
    # Part 2
    #=====================
    strategy = 1,
    hrs.del.start = 0,          hrs.del.end = 0,
    maxdur = 9,                 includedaycrit = 16,
    qwindow=c(0,24),
    mvpathreshold =c(100),
    bout.metric = 6,
    excludefirstlast = FALSE,
    includenightcrit = 16,
    #=====================
    # Part 3 + 4
    #=====================
    def.noc.sleep = 1,
    outliers.only = TRUE,
    criterror = 4,
    do.visual = TRUE,
    #=====================
    # Part for time series
    #=====================
    epochvalues2csv = TRUE,
    save_ms5rawlevels=TRUE,
    save_ms5raw_format ="csv",
    save_ms5raw_without_invalid = FALSE,
    windowsizes = c(900,900,3600),
    do.mad = TRUE,
    overwrite = TRUE,
    #=====================
    # Part 5
    #=====================
    threshold.lig = c(30), threshold.mod = c(100),  threshold.vig = c(400),
    boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
    boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
    boutdur.mvpa = c(1),
    includedaycrit.part5 = 2/3,
    #=====================
    # Visual report
    #=====================
    timewindow = c("WW"),
    visualreport=TRUE)

We changed the windowsizes to c(900,900,3600) but get an error:

1 P3 file NAFilename not recognisedError in readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE) : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning messages:
1: closing unused connection 10 (<-localhost:11285)
2: closing unused connection 9 (<-localhost:11285)
3: closing unused connection 8 (<-localhost:11285)
4: closing unused connection 7 (<-localhost:11285)
5: closing unused connection 6 (<-localhost:11285)
6: closing unused connection 5 (<-localhost:11285)
7: closing unused connection 4 (<-localhost:11285)
8: closing unused connection 3 (<-localhost:11285)
9: In readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE) :
  cannot open compressed file '/home/output_data-raw/meta/basic/meta_NA', probable reason 'No such file or directory'

How should we change the windowsizes to get the datas (timestamp, angelz, ENMO, MAD) for every quarter hour ?
Any help/tips would be greatly appreciated.

Best,

Elif

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] processing the metashort csv. data for every quarter hour (15 min)
parts:
Dear Elif,

It sounds like GGIR code is not designed to have short and long epoch size being identical.
Also, other functionalities may not work well when epoch length is longer than a minutes.

My approach would be to store the data per minute and to do the 15 minute aggregation yourself with R functions like aggregate() or similar.

Best,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
